_comment: Official Odysseus plugin registry. Submit a plugin by opening a PR that adds an entry here. Each plugin lives in its own repo (DokuWiki-InfoBox model); `download` is an https zip whose root contains the plugin's files (plugin.py + assets) and `sha256` of that zip is verified before install. The in-app Plugins -> Browse tab reads this file. Add more sources in the UI, or override the base with ODYSSEUS_PLUGIN_REGISTRY (comma-separated) for a fork/private registry. The bundled plugins/example is an in-tree template, not listed here.

plugins.name: Cloudflare Tunnel
plugins.author: kanaru-dev
plugins.description: Expose Odysseus remotely over a Cloudflare tunnel (quick or named). Login is still required to reach the app.

plugins.name: MCP Server
plugins.author: kanaru-dev
plugins.description: Expose Odysseus to external MCP clients (Claude Code, Cursor, …) over Streamable HTTP so they can run its tools. Reuses Odysseus auth (API token).

plugins.name: Image → Splat
plugins.author: kanaru-dev
plugins.description: Turn a gallery image into a 3D Gaussian Splat with Apple SHARP, with a built-in WebGL viewer. Model downloaded on demand (not bundled).
